name: Opus Value
strategy: Quality-momentum / trend-following: own demonstrated relative-strength leaders (momentum & quality factor ETFs + top above-200dma names) with income/quality ballast and hard stops.
novelty: The return driver is momentum and trend persistence — buying assets already going UP — plus quality/carry ballast. This is the deliberate opposite of R1 (buying cheap value) and R2 (buying oversold mean-reversion): laggards (BTC, ETH, GLD, MSFT below 200dma) are explicitly excluded.

positions.thesis: S&P 500 momentum factor ETF - core embodiment of the trend edge.
Broad US momentum factor - rebalances out of fading names.
Top single-name momentum leader (+26% 6m), quality mega-cap above 200dma.
Quality factor - quality-at-any-price sleeve, lower-vol trend.
Energy momentum diversifier - low correlation to tech.
Covered-call income/carry sleeve - reduces reversal whipsaw.

backtest.notes: Beat SPY in stress and 3 of 5 windows; mild lag where ballast diluted upside. A naive top-6 rotation was rejected for whipsaw.

outlook: Momentum leadership concentrated in US tech/quality plus energy; main risk is factor reversal, blunted by ballast and 12-20% stops.
